finding: Robot learning suggests a high-throughput loop: parallel experience generation, controlled variation, explicit objective/reward, policy update, held-out evaluation, sim-to-real/transfer validation, and continual collection of failure cases.

cerebron_translation.environment: Problem/task generator + real historical tasks + adversarial variants
cerebron_translation.observation: Prompt, context, evidence state, dependencies, tool availability
cerebron_translation.action: Routing, decomposition, tool choice, hypothesis, experiment, answer delta
cerebron_translation.reward: Deterministic measured task score; never self-reported confidence
cerebron_translation.parallel_simulation: Many cheap synthetic task variants and counterfactuals, clearly tagged synthetic
cerebron_translation.domain_randomization: Vary wording, domain, missing information, distractors, tool availability, contradiction patterns and dependency structure
cerebron_translation.demonstrations: Validated expert trajectories and successful audited CEREBRON traces
cerebron_translation.failure_replay: RED/OPEN/REJECT and regression cases become negative/correction curriculum after validation
cerebron_translation.sim_to_real: Synthetic curriculum -> cold real held-out tasks -> transfer domains -> production shadow evaluation
cerebron_translation.promotion: Cold no-RAG + transfer no-RAG + ablation + regression + F72 + AFAH

next_experiment: Build a small CEREBRON learning simulator with parallel task variants and deterministic rewards, then compare G0 vs reversible G1 adapter.
